actions.message: Contributing 80%+ benefits everyone. Free-riders will be punished.

answer.explanation: Wallet is above 30% of initial endowment, so baseline 80% contribution is required. Round 11 is a norm broadcast round (every 5 rounds), so we both contribute 80% of the wallet and broadcast the norm.

message.reasoning:

Also baseline contribution 80% of wallet since wallet 202.47 >30% initial. Must contribute at least 80% of current wallet. But only one physical action allowed per round, and broadcast is communication. So we can contribute and also broadcast? That's two actions: one physical and one communication allowed (max one each). So we can do both. Need contribute >=80% of wallet: 0.8*202.47=161.976. Should contribute that amount. Ensure wallet has enough (it does). So action contribute amount 161.98 (round to maybe two decimals). And broadcast message norm.
